messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased error rate detected on hosted inference gateway (region=eu-west). P50 latency spike and 5xx rate rising over last 2m. Auto-remediation attempted: stalled. Paging on-call.
alex: I'm on it. seeing 502s from backend shards, but Dedicated pool eu-prod-ded-1 shows CPU at 99% and queue depth climbing.
sara: Confirmed. Several customers reporting timeouts. Which mitigation do we want first — burst capacity, scale up, or rate-limit?
mike: If we spin up more dedicated replicas it could take 2-3m. Burst capacity toggle gives immediate headroom for short spikes. I'd go burst + temporary rate-limit.
jen: +1 to burst then rate-limit. Also we should check autoscaler logs to see if a policy is blocking scale.
infra-bot: autoscaler:policy=standard for eu-prod-ded-1, current_replicas=8, max_replicas=8, pending_scale_up=false. Reason: max_replicas hit.
alex: there it is — pool is capped. We can either bump max_replicas or enable burst (burst borrows capacity from shared reserved). Quick plan: enable burst for 30m, set per-customer soft rate-limits for top noisy orgs, then increase max_replicas to 12 if still trending.
sara: I'll craft the commands. tagging @pagerduty-bot to note mitigation steps.
jen: Customer impact: which orgs are most affected? Can we get a list by 10s buckets?
mike: Top offenders from logs: org:acme-inc (30% of spike), org:streamlytics (18%), generic anonymous bot traffic 25%. We should throttle anonymous clients first.
alex: executing burst toggle now. Command: ```/infra toggle-burst eu-prod-ded-1 enable duration=30m reason="traffic_surge_178250"```. Pushing.
infra-bot: action=toggle-burst status=success pool=eu-prod-ded-1 duration=30m active_until=1782503134 note="manual enable by alex"
sara: Burst enabled :thumbsup:. I'm pushing soft rate-limits: anonymous -> 30 rpm, acme-inc -> 120 rpm (was unlimited), streamlytics -> 80 rpm. Command: ```/api rate-limit set --scope anonymous --rpm 30 --reason "protect_pool"
/api rate-limit set --org acme-inc --rpm 120 --reason "protect_pool"
/api rate-limit set --org streamlytics --rpm 80 --reason "protect_pool"```
pagerduty-bot: Incident note appended. Mitigations: burst enabled, rate-limits applied. Notifying customers in affected list.
alex: watching metrics — queue depth dropped 40% in last 30s, 5xx rate trending down. If sustained for 3m we can skip increasing max_replicas.
jen: I'm still seeing some throttled client retries creating backlog. Suggest we also enable short-term caching for prefix hits on the most common prompt patterns — low-risk and fast to flip.
mike: Cache toggle command: ```/infra set-cache-policy eu-prod-ded-1 prefix_cache=on ttl=60s targets=top_patterns```. I'll run after you sign off.
sara: Go ahead. Doing it now.
infra-bot: cache:update status=success pool=eu-prod-ded-1 policy=prefix_cache ttl=60s targets=top_patterns note="emergency mitigation"
alex: 2m since burst and rate-limits. Latency p95 back to normal, 5xx down >70%. Leaving burst on for 30m but set to auto-disable earlier if stable.
jen: Decision note: Do not increase max_replicas yet. Keep burst for now and monitor; follow-up action to review autoscaler max_replicas policy for that pool within the day.
sara: I'll create a follow-up task in eng-oncall board: investigate why max_replicas was set to 8 for eu-prod-ded-1 and whether we need dynamic bumping rules.
mike: Oncall handoff at 1782501200+15m for night team — @alex you good to hand to @sara in 20m?
alex: Yes handing to @sara. Summary: burst enabled (30m), soft rate-limits applied to noisy orgs/anonymous, prefix cache enabled. Monitor for 15m, escalate if 5xx > 1% or queue depth increases >20% from baseline.
sara: Taking it over. I'll post a post-incident summary after stabilization and update customers.
inc-bot: Incident resolved: current status=mitigated; actions_taken=[burst_enabled, rate_limits, prefix_cache]; next_steps=[review_autoscaler_policy, postmortem]. Closed? please ack.
alex: ack :white_check_mark:. Thanks everyone.
sara: ack. I'll file the follow-up and schedule a quick sync with infra owning autoscaler rules.
jen: ack — please add cost estimate for burst usage in postmortem.
mike: ack — will pull billing delta.
pagerduty-bot: Incident ticket updated and on-call handover recorded.
